trial_eval_limit.description: Maximum number of llm_judge runs the team may execute on PostHog trial credits.

trial_evals_used.description: Number of llm_judge runs already consumed against the trial credit pool.

trial_evals_remaining.description: Number of trial evaluation runs remaining before the team must supply its own provider key.

active_provider_key.description: Provider key currently used to run llm_judge evaluations. Null when the team is on trial credits.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the evaluation config row was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the evaluation config row was last modified.
